description: Backend foundation: project layout, pinned dependencies, env config, SQLAlchemy engine/session/Base, the FULL relational schema (all 14 tables), password+JWT security helpers, FastAPI app with CORS for localhost:5173, DB auto-init+seed on startup, reference+demo seed data, and git repo init so later phases can commit and reviewers can diff. This phase writes no business endpoints except /api/health; later phases add routers that use these models.
steps: Init a git repo at e:/SIH26262 (run `git init` if no .git exists). Create e:/SIH26262/.gitignore ignoring: node_modules/, frontend/dist/, backend/venv/, backend/__pycache__/, backend/app/__pycache__/, backend/nexora.db, backend/*.db, backend/uploads/, .env, .agents/tasks/*/review.json. `git add -A` the existing scaffolding and commit as 'chore: baseline scaffolding'.

Extend e:/SIH26262/backend/requirements.txt with pinned exact versions (keep existing fastapi==0.115.0, uvicorn==0.30.6, python-multipart==0.0.9): sqlalchemy==2.0.36, pydantic-settings==2.6.1, pydantic[email]==2.9.2, email-validator==2.2.0, pyjwt==2.9.0, passlib==1.7.4, bcrypt==4.2.1, apscheduler==3.10.4. Do NOT add pytesseract/pdfplumber/Pillow (optional, imported defensively later).

Create e:/SIH26262/backend/app/config.py using pydantic-settings BaseSettings: DATABASE_URL default 'sqlite:///./nexora.db', JWT_SECRET (default to a dev value, overridable by env), JWT_ALG='HS256', ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRE_MINUTES=480, CORS_ORIGINS='http://localhost:5173', SMTP_HOST/PORT/USER/PASSWORD/FROM (empty strings). Load .env via SettingsConfigDict(env_file='.env').

Create e:/SIH26262/backend/app/database.py: create_engine(Settings.DATABASE_URL, connect_args={'check_same_thread': False} for sqlite), SessionLocal, declarative Base, get_db() FastAPI dependency, init_db() that calls Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine) then seed_demo_data() if DB is empty.

Create e:/SIH26262/backend/app/models.py defining ALL 14 models with PKs, FKs, timestamps, constraints and indexes (enum values as String with CHECK constraints or Python enums): User(id, email unique+index, full_name, password_hash, role in {institution,regional_officer,bureau_officer,evc_committee,admin}, region nullable, institution_id FK nullable, is_active default true, created_at); Institution(id, name, region, created_at); Application(id string 'APP-YYYY-NNNN' unique, institution_id FK, region index, application_type, submitted_at index, current_stage string, status index, assigned_officer_id FK User nullable, deadline nullable, priority, scenario_tag nullable, created_at, updated_at); ApplicationStage(id, application_id FK index, stage_key, stage_name, entered_at, exited_at nullable, status in {active,completed,returned}, actor_user_id FK, reason nullable); WorkflowRules(id, stage_key unique+index, stage_name, stage_order int, requires_scrutiny bool, requires_evc bool, requires_committee bool, allowed_roles string(comma list), deadline_days int nullable, is_active bool default true, created_at, updated_at); ScrutinyObservations(id, application_id FK index, officer_id FK, observation_text, is_deficiency bool, severity, created_at); Documents(id, application_id FK nullable, institution_id FK index, category string, file_name, stored_path, mime_type, file_size int, uploaded_by FK, uploaded_at, expiry_date nullable index, ocr_text nullable, status in {uploaded,under_verification,verified,deficient,rejected,expiring_soon,expired} index, verified_by FK nullable, verified_at nullable, replacement_for FK self nullable, created_at); DocumentVerifications(id, document_id FK, verifier_id FK, status, remarks, is_ocr_attempted bool, ocr_summary nullable, created_at); EVCAppointments(id, application_id FK index, scheduled_date index, location, committee_members string(JSON user ids), status in {scheduled,completed,cancelled} index, completed_at nullable, completed_by FK nullable, findings nullable, recommendation nullable, created_at); Undertakings(id, application_id FK, institution_id FK index, description, due_date, submitted_at nullable, evidence_document_id FK nullable, status in {pending,submitted,verified,deficient,overdue} index, verifying_officer_id FK nullable, remarks nullable, created_at, updated_at); ComplianceSubmissions(id, institution_id FK index, application_id FK nullable, undertaking_id FK nullable, description, due_date index, submitted_at nullable, evidence_document_id FK nullable, verification_status in {pending,submitted,verified,deficient,overdue} index, verifying_officer_id FK nullable, remarks nullable, created_at, updated_at); Notifications(id, event_type, related_id string, recipient_id FK index, message, created_at index, due_date nullable, is_read bool default false index, action_link nullable); Escalations(id, application_id FK nullable, compliance_id FK nullable, level int, from_user_id FK, to_user_id FK, reason, created_at, resolved bool default false); AuditLogs(id, user_id FK, action, affected_record_type, affected_record_id string, previous_status nullable, updated_status nullable, reason nullable, workflow_stage nullable, timestamp index).
Create e:/SIH26262/backend/app/security.py: passlib CryptContext(bcrypt) hash_password/verify_password; PyJWT create_access_token(subject=user_id, role, exp) and decode_access_token(token)->payload.

Create e:/SIH26262/backend/app/seed.py: seed_demo_data(db) idempotent (skip if Users table non-empty). Seed: 5 regions (North, South, East, West, Central); WorkflowRules rows for the configurable pipeline (submission, initial_scrutiny, deficiency_check, evc_scheduling, evc_completion, committee_stage, authorised_decision, final_status) with stage_order and requires_* flags and allowed_roles; document categories (Lease Documents, Land and Building Documents, Institutional Undertakings, Approval Supporting Documents, Compliance Evidence, Other Prescribed Documents); default reminder intervals stored as WorkflowRules/config rows or a small config table - simplest: store reminder/escalation config in WorkflowRules-like rows is awkward; instead create the 5 demo Users (one per role) with known passwords (hash via security.hash_password) and 6 fictional Institutions across regions. All names are clearly fictional. Mark demo via a is_demo flag where helpful.

Rewrite e:/SIH26262/backend/app/main.py: keep FastAPI(title='NEXORA AICTE API'); set CORSMiddleware allow_origins=Settings.CORS_ORIGINS.split(','), allow_credentials=True, allow_methods=['*'], allow_headers=['*']; add startup event that calls init_db(); keep GET /api/health returning {status:'ok',service:'nexora-aicte-backend',db:'ok'}. Remove the hardcoded /api/dashboard,/api/applications,/api/compliance endpoints (they move to real routers in later phases) - or keep /api/dashboard as a thin placeholder returning empty arrays until FEAT-003; safer to remove and re-add properly in FEAT-003 to avoid fake numbers.

Create e:/SIH26262/backend/.env.example with all Settings keys and a dev JWT_SECRET placeholder, DATABASE_URL=sqlite:///./nexora.db, empty SMTP_*; comment that SMTP empty means email unconfigured. No real secrets.

Create backend venv and install: from e:/SIH26262/backend run `python -m venv venv` then `venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pip install -r requirements.txt`. Confirm import works: `venv\Scripts\python.exe -c "from app.main import app; from app.database import init_db; init_db(); print('ok')"` from the backend dir (creates nexora.db, creates all tables, seeds).

Commit on the repo: `git add -A` then `git commit -m 'FEAT-001: backend foundation, full schema, seed, git init'` recording the exact commands run and their results (uvicorn start, table count, seed user count) in the commit message body.
acceptance_criteria: All 14 SQLAlchemy models are defined and create_all produces the tables (sqlite file created).
uvicorn app.main:app starts on :8000 without import errors and the startup event initializes+seeds the DB.
seed_demo_data is idempotent (running twice does not duplicate users).
5 demo users (one per role) and 6 fictional institutions exist after seed; querying models.User.count() returns >=5.
git repo exists at e:/SIH26262 with a baseline commit plus the FEAT-001 commit.
requirements.txt pins exact versions only; no optional OCR libs added.
verification: cd e:/SIH26262/backend && python -m venv venv && venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pip install -r requirements.txt  (exit 0)

cd e:/SIH26262/backend && venv\Scripts\python.exe -c "from app.database import init_db; init_db(); from app.database import SessionLocal; from app import models; s=SessionLocal(); print('users=', s.query(models.User).count(), 'institutions=', s.query(models.Institution).count(), 'rules=', s.query(models.WorkflowRules).count())"  (prints users>=5, institutions>=6, rules>=8)
cd e:/SIH26262/backend && venv\Scripts\python.exe -m uvicorn app.main:app --port 8000 starts; in another shell: curl http://localhost:8000/api/health returns {"status":"ok"}
git -C e:/SIH26262 log --oneline shows the baseline commit and the FEAT-001 commit
